source.title: EOS-CG-2021: A Mixture Model for the Calculation of Thermodynamic Properties of CCS Mixtures
source.authors: Neumann, Herrig, Bell, Beckmueller, Lemmon, Thol and Span
source.table4: Reducing parameters and Fij values for all binary mixtures required to implement the full mixture model

componentOrderPolicy: Use the paper's i-j order for beta parameters; reciprocal beta values are required if the implementation reverses the pair order.

table4TargetPairs.reference: GERG-2008 / Kunz-Wagner as cited by EOS-CG-2021 reference [6]
table4TargetPairs.notes: EOS-CG-2021 inherits this pair from GERG-2008; these values are the reciprocal-order form of the PR #42 CO2+N2 Gernert/GERG record.

table4TargetPairs.reference: Gernert-Span / EOS-CG-2016 as cited by EOS-CG-2021 reference [5]
table4TargetPairs.notes: No binary departure function is active because Fij is zero.

table4TargetPairs.reference: Lovseth et al. as cited by EOS-CG-2021 reference [87]
table4TargetPairs.notes: This is the updated EOS-CG-2021 Ar formulation and must not be replaced by the older PR #43 diagnostic pair.

table4TargetPairs.reference: Beckmueller et al. as cited by EOS-CG-2021 reference [7]
table4TargetPairs.notes: Dedicated EOS-CG-2021 hydrogen binary; paper text notes later speed-of-sound deviations that must be handled property-by-property.

table4TargetPairs.reference: GERG-2008 / Kunz-Wagner as cited by EOS-CG-2021 reference [6]
table4TargetPairs.notes: EOS-CG-2021 inherits the GERG CO2+CH4 pair; reciprocal beta handling is required if evaluated as CO2+CH4.

directConstructionProbe.engine: pinned teqp v0.23.1 headers and vendored fluid data
directConstructionProbe.purpose: Confirm that PhaseXpert's EOS-CG-2021 target Table 4/5 records can be represented by teqp's multifluid builder before production validation.
directConstructionProbe.notes: The probe constructed custom multifluid models for all listed pairs with finite mixture gas constants. This is a construction check only; it is not density, VLE, phase-equilibrium or property validation.
